lines: Wilson saw 10.3 targets per game over his last 3 games, up from 8.2 on the season, with a 33% target share.
His usage was worth 19.3 expected PPR points per game over his last 3, but he scored 12.3 per game.
Week 12 is at Miami, which allows the 29th-most PPR points per game to receivers. Coach Aaron Glenn said Wilson will remain a primary target.
